purpose: Landmark-compatible constraint system for selecting the canonical shoulder girdle without fitting back to the r95 mesh.

clavicle_endpoint_length_mm.definition: straight 3D distance between lateral-most clavicular point in AC joint and medial-most clavicular point in SC joint

derived_constraints.hard_width_failure: Current a003 bi-AC breadth exceeds the expected outer biacromial breadth even though each AC joint must lie medial to the lateral acromial landmark.

hard_geometry_rules: each_SC_to_AC_3D_chord must be checked against endpoint-compatible adult-male clavicle evidence
AC and GH remain distinct centres
lateral acromion remains lateral to AC joint
left/right canonical geometry follows the declared symmetry/asymmetry policy
acceptance_logic: Reject any candidate whose bi-AC breadth equals or exceeds bilateral lateral-acromion (biacromial) breadth.
Reject any candidate whose SC-to-AC straight chord exceeds the clavicle curved centreline length.
Do not derive AC offset by subtracting two distances to a third landmark unless collinearity is demonstrated.
Do not freeze absolute SC/AC coordinates until SC breadth and a direct/derived landmark-compatible AC placement constraint are available.
Do not force scapular GH-to-inferior-angle from height-only evidence.
Do not move the whole shoulder vertically just to repair width.
interpretation: The a003 shoulder-width failure remains independently confirmed by outer biacromial breadth and clavicle length.
The exact amount of medial AC relocation is not yet frozen because the previously used 34±8 mm direct AC-offset claim was a source-transcription error.
Target selection therefore remains deliberately blocked at absolute SC/AC coordinates while verified constraints are retained.
next_steps: Solve SC/AC/acromion coordinates in 3D against the clavicle endpoint/centreline constraints and global shoulder-height scaffold.
Build the scapular local landmark frame independently, then place GH from the retained local depth and glenoid geometry.
Rerun shoulder-complex solver tests after the canonical girdle coordinates are instantiated.

audit_correction_2026_10_08.issue: Direct lateral-acromion→AC distance had been inferred incorrectly from a 2026 cadaver paper.
audit_correction_2026_10_08.correction: Removed that input and all exact AC-breadth derivations depending on it.
unchanged_findings: a003 SC→AC chord grossly exceeds adult male clavicle endpoint/centreline evidence
